title: From Interaction to Capability: Task Advancement as State and Supervision for GUI Agents
title_zh: 从交互到能力：以任务推进作为GUI智能体的状态与监督

paragraphs.en: GUI memory should preserve the results of past actions and learn reusable operations. This is difficult in long-horizon workflows, where agents must use information across applications and useful operations are interleaved with failed attempts. We introduce Task Advancement Memory ( TAM ), which defines task advancement as verified task progress, and supports ongoing task execution and learns reusable operations. During execution, Task Advancement State represents how verified task progress changes the remaining goals, allowing the agent to build on earlier achievements across applications. After each task, advancement supervision identifies and abstracts the interactions that produced a verified local result. The learned operations preserve the relation between required inputs, expected outcomes, and verification conditions. This retains locally successful operations from both successful and failed tasks. On MobileWorld GUI-only tasks, Advancement State alone raises success from 12.0% to 28.2%. Full TAM achieves a 17.6% relative gain in task success over the strongest evaluated baseline and reduces lifecycle tokens per solved task by 38.7%. On SPA-Bench, TAM achieves state-of-the-art task success in the single-app English Level 3 setting.
paragraphs.zh: GUI 记忆应当保存过去动作的结果，并学习可复用的操作。 这在长时程工作流中十分困难：智能体需要跨应用使用信息，而有用的操作往往与失败的尝试交织在一起。 我们提出任务推进记忆（TAM），它将任务推进定义为经验证的任务进展，支持持续的任务执行并学习可复用的操作。 在执行过程中，任务推进状态表示经验证的任务进展如何改变剩余目标，使智能体能够跨应用在已有成果的基础上继续推进。 每完成一个任务后，推进监督会识别并抽象出那些产生了经验证的局部结果的交互。 所学到的操作保留了所需输入、预期结果与验证条件之间的关系。 这使得来自成功任务和失败任务中的局部成功操作都能得以保留。 在 MobileWorld 仅 GUI 任务上，仅使用推进状态就能将成功率从 12.0% 提升到 28.2%。 完整的 TAM 在任务成功率上相对最强的被评估基线取得 17.6% 的提升，并将每个已解决任务的生命周期 token 数降低 38.7%。 在 SPA-Bench 上，TAM 在单应用英文 Level 3 设定下取得了最先进的任务成功率。

paragraphs.en: GUI agents should complete workflows whose information and effects are distributed across screens and applications. Long interaction histories mix completed work with attempts and productive actions with detours, leaving the agent to reconstruct how far the task has advanced and what remains to be done. For example, after confirming a calendar event, an agent should proceed to notifying participants using the event details it has already read. Therefore, memory should represent how completed work changes the remaining task.
paragraphs.zh: GUI智能体应能完成那些信息和效果分布在多个屏幕和应用程序中的工作流程。 冗长的交互历史将已完成的工作与尝试、有效的操作与弯路混杂在一起，智能体需要自行重构任务已推进到什么程度以及还有哪些工作要做。 例如，在确认日历事件后，智能体应利用它已经读取的事件详情继续通知参与者。 因此，记忆应当表示已完成的工作如何改变了剩余任务。

paragraphs.en: Recent methods improve the information available to the agent through context management, program-guided execution, and verified task state ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026b ) . Trajectory exemplars, induced workflows, and experience memories also transfer knowledge to later tasks ( Zheng et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Ouyang et al., 2026 ) . These approaches address how memory can help an agent complete remaining goals and how successful interactions can become reusable operations. However, agents still struggle to apply correctly acquired information to later goals across applications. Workflow memories tied to historical action sequences also leave the agent to adapt past routes when the interface changes. A task’s final outcome also gives incomplete feedback about intermediate operations, a failed task can contain useful successes, while a successful task can include ineffective attempts.
paragraphs.zh: 近期方法通过上下文管理、程序引导执行和经过验证的任务状态来改善智能体可获得的信息 ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Tian et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026b ) 。 轨迹范例、归纳出的工作流以及经验记忆也能将知识迁移到后续任务 ( Zheng et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Ouyang et al., 2026 ) 。 这些方法研究的是记忆如何帮助智能体完成剩余目标，以及成功的交互如何成为可复用的操作。 然而，智能体在跨应用场景下仍难以将正确获取的信息应用于后续目标。 与历史动作序列绑定的记忆工作流也让智能体在界面发生变化时只能自行调整过去的路线。 任务的最终结果对中间操作也只能提供不完整的反馈：失败的任务中可能包含有用的成功步骤，而成功的任务中也可能包含无效的尝试。

paragraphs.en: We propose Task Advancement Memory (TAM), a memory framework that uses task progress to guide execution and learning. A task advancement occurs when GUI observations confirm that a previously unresolved requirement is satisfied, either by obtaining required information or by achieving a requested outcome. Each advancement reduces what the agent still needs to determine or accomplish. We call this task reduction . For online execution, Task Advancement State makes earlier advancements usable by later goals. It shows what information is available for each remaining goal and which goals are ready to pursue. TAM uses each advancement to supervise the selection and abstraction of productive interactions. The learned operations specify the inputs needed at entry, the result to achieve, and how to verify it. This retains useful capabilities from productive portions of both successful and failed workflows. Figure 1 illustrates these two uses of task advancement.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出任务推进记忆（Task Advancement Memory，TAM），这是一个利用任务进展来指导执行与学习的记忆框架。 当 GUI 观察确认某个先前未解决的需求已被满足时，无论是获得了所需信息还是达成了所要求的结果，就发生了一次任务推进。 每次推进都会减少智能体仍需确定或完成的内容。 我们将此称为任务削减（task reduction）。 在在线执行中，任务推进状态使先前的推进能够被后续目标所利用。 它显示每个剩余目标可用的信息，以及哪些目标已可以着手推进。 TAM 利用每次推进来监督对具有成效的交互的选择与抽象。 所学习的操作指明进入时所需的输入、要达成的结果以及如何验证该结果。 这保留了来自成功与失败工作流中有成效部分的有用能力。 图 1 展示了任务推进的这两种用途。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate TAM on the GUI-only subset of MobileWorld ( Kong et al., 2026 ) and the Level-3 English subset of SPA-Bench ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . With Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct used by every listed MobileWorld method, TAM improves success from 29.1% for the strongest evaluated memory baseline to 34.2%. With GPT-4o in the SPA-Bench English Level 3 setting, it reaches 57.0%, the highest success rate in the reported comparison. Our contributions are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 MobileWorld 的纯 GUI 子集（Kong et al., 2026）和 SPA-Bench 的 Level-3 英文子集（Chen et al., 2025）上评估 TAM。 在每个列出的 MobileWorld 方法均使用 Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct 的情况下，TAM 将成功率从所评估的最强记忆基线的 29.1% 提升至 34.2%。 在 SPA-Bench 英文 Level 3 设置下使用 GPT-4o 时，TAM 达到 57.0%，是所报告对比中最高的成功率。 我们的贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: We introduce Task Advancement State within TAM to guide execution across applications. It represents the remaining task in terms of satisfied requirements, available inputs, and unresolved dependencies. This lets the agent build on earlier advancements when choosing its next action.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在TAM中引入任务推进状态，以指导跨应用程序的执行。 它从已满足的需求、可用的输入和未解决的依赖关系的角度表示剩余任务。 这使智能体在选择下一个动作时能够基于先前的推进成果。

sents.zh: 我们在TAM中引入任务推进状态，以指导跨应用程序的执行。

sents.zh: 这使智能体在选择下一个动作时能够基于先前的推进成果。

paragraphs.en: We propose advancement supervision , which converts partial task success into capabilities that can be reused in subsequent tasks. Each learned operation specifies what it needs, what it should achieve, and how to verify the outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出进阶监督（advancement supervision），它将部分任务成功转化为可在后续任务中复用的能力。 每个学到的操作都 specifies 它需要什么、应该达成什么，以及如何验证结果。

paragraphs.en: We show that TAM outperforms the evaluated memory baselines in task success on MobileWorld and SPA-Bench. Cross-benchmark comparisons, component ablations, and cost analyses establish the value of task-state memory and the additional benefit of persistent operators.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，TAM 在 MobileWorld 和 SPA-Bench 上的任务成功率优于所评估的各类记忆基线。 跨基准对比、组件消融实验和成本分析确立了任务状态记忆的价值，以及持久智能体带来的额外收益。

sents.en: We show that TAM outperforms the evaluated memory baselines in task success on MobileWorld and SPA-Bench.
sents.zh: 我们证明，TAM 在 MobileWorld 和 SPA-Bench 上的任务成功率优于所评估的各类记忆基线。

sents.en: Cross-benchmark comparisons, component ablations, and cost analyses establish the value of task-state memory and the additional benefit of persistent operators.
sents.zh: 跨基准对比、组件消融实验和成本分析确立了任务状态记忆的价值，以及持久智能体带来的额外收益。

paragraphs.en: Explicit task representations preserve information and unfinished work across interface changes. AgentProg represents task variables and control flow; ATMem maintains task-driving information and execution status; TSR separates durable task information from transient observations; and StructAgent combines requirements, values, evidence, and verified transitions ( Tian et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . MGA also organizes interaction around validated state changes ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) . These methods preserve explicit task information and distinguish intended actions from observed outcomes. TAM links task results to the remaining requirements they support. These dependencies guide execution and define the inputs and outcomes of reusable operations.
paragraphs.zh: 显式任务表示能够在接口变化中保存信息和未完成的工作。 AgentProg 表示任务变量与控制流；ATMem 维护任务驱动信息和执行状态；TSR 将持久任务信息与瞬态观察分离；StructAgent 则结合需求、价值、证据与经过验证的状态转移 ( Tian et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Zheng et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) 。 MGA 同样围绕经过验证的状态变化来组织交互 ( Cheng et al., 2025 ) 。 这些方法保存显式任务信息，并区分预期动作与观察到的结果。 TAM 将任务结果与其所支持的剩余需求关联起来。 这些依赖关系指导执行，并定义可复用操作的输入与结果。

paragraphs.en: Persistent experience can guide later tasks through demonstrations, trajectories, workflows, or skills. Synapse retrieves abstracted trajectories as in-context exemplars; AWM induces workflows from offline or online experience; and ReasoningBank distills reusable reasoning strategies ( Zheng et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Ouyang et al., 2026 ) . Mobile-Agent-E stores tips and shortcuts, UI-Mem organizes workflows, subtask skills, and failure patterns, and SkillGen synthesizes and validates skills from successful and unsuccessful trajectories ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) . These systems reuse experience at different granularities. They adopt different rules for locating a reusable segment, assigning local credit, and verifying the result that the segment is expected to achieve. TAM selects interactions by the local requirement they satisfy and carries that requirement into the learned operation’s expected outcome and verification condition.
paragraphs.zh: 持久化经验可以通过演示、轨迹、工作流或技能来指导后续任务。 Synapse 检索抽象化后的轨迹作为上下文内示例；AWM 从离线或在线经验中归纳工作流；ReasoningBank 则提炼可复用的推理策略（Zheng et al., 2024b; Wang et al., 2025b; Ouyang et al., 2026）。 Mobile-Agent-E 存储提示与捷径，UI-Mem 组织工作流、子任务技能和失败模式，SkillGen 则从成功与失败的轨迹中合成并验证技能（Wang et al., 2025a; Xiao et al., 2026; Ma et al., 2026）。 这些系统以不同的粒度复用经验。 它们采用不同的规则来定位可复用片段、为局部分配功劳，并验证该片段预期达成的结果。 TAM 根据交互所满足的局部需求来选择交互，并将该需求转化为所学操作的预期结果与验证条件。

sents.en: Persistent experience can guide later tasks through demonstrations, trajectories, workflows, or skills.
sents.zh: 持久化经验可以通过演示、轨迹、工作流或技能来指导后续任务。

sents.en: Synapse retrieves abstracted trajectories as in-context exemplars; AWM induces workflows from offline or online experience; and ReasoningBank distills reusable reasoning strategies ( Zheng et al., 2024b ; Wang et al., 2025b ; Ouyang et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: Synapse 检索抽象化后的轨迹作为上下文内示例；AWM 从离线或在线经验中归纳工作流；ReasoningBank 则提炼可复用的推理策略（Zheng et al., 2024b; Wang et al., 2025b; Ouyang et al., 2026）。

sents.en: Mobile-Agent-E stores tips and shortcuts, UI-Mem organizes workflows, subtask skills, and failure patterns, and SkillGen synthesizes and validates skills from successful and unsuccessful trajectories ( Wang et al., 2025a ; Xiao et al., 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: Mobile-Agent-E 存储提示与捷径，UI-Mem 组织工作流、子任务技能和失败模式，SkillGen 则从成功与失败的轨迹中合成并验证技能（Wang et al., 2025a; Xiao et al., 2026; Ma et al., 2026）。

sents.en: These systems reuse experience at different granularities.
sents.zh: 这些系统以不同的粒度复用经验。

sents.en: They adopt different rules for locating a reusable segment, assigning local credit, and verifying the result that the segment is expected to achieve.
sents.zh: 它们采用不同的规则来定位可复用片段、为局部分配功劳，并验证该片段预期达成的结果。

sents.en: TAM selects interactions by the local requirement they satisfy and carries that requirement into the learned operation’s expected outcome and verification condition.
sents.zh: TAM 根据交互所满足的局部需求来选择交互，并将该需求转化为所学操作的预期结果与验证条件。

paragraphs.en: Another family constructs persistent knowledge through dedicated exploration. AppAgent builds application knowledge from exploration or demonstrations; GUI-Xplore learns action-aware structure from exploration videos; GUI-explorer generates function-aware exploration goals and mines transition knowledge; ActionEngine builds state-machine memory with an offline crawler; and EAM constructs an executable GUI graph through state-aware exploration ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2025 ; Zhong et al., 2026 ; Qin et al., 2026 ) . This approach can provide broad interface coverage before downstream tasks are attempted.
paragraphs.zh: 另一类方法家族通过专门的探索来构建持久化知识。 AppAgent 通过探索或演示来构建应用知识；GUI-Xplore 从探索视频中学习具有动作感知的结构；GUI-explorer 生成具有功能感知的探索目标并挖掘转移知识；ActionEngine 借助离线爬虫构建状态机记忆；EAM 则通过具有状态感知的探索构建可执行的 GUI 图（Zhang et al., 2025；Sun et al., 2025；Xie et al., 2025；Zhong et al., 2026；Qin et al., 2026）。 这种方法可以在尝试下游任务之前提供广泛的界面覆盖。

sents.en: Another family constructs persistent knowledge through dedicated exploration.

paragraphs.en: TAM uses task advancement in two ways. Task Advancement State represents what remains to be done using the information already obtained. Advancement supervision learns reusable operations from interactions that satisfy a task requirement. These memories guide a fixed base policy, which chooses primitive actions from the live interface (Figure 2 ). Appendix A gives the execution procedure, update rules, and learning details.
paragraphs.zh: TAM 通过两种方式利用任务推进。 任务推进状态使用已获得的信息来表示尚待完成的内容。 推进监督从满足任务要求的交互中学习可复用的操作。 这些记忆指导一个固定的基础策略，该策略从实时界面中选择基本动作（图 2）。 附录 A 给出了执行流程、更新规则和学习细节。

sents.zh: 推进监督从满足任务要求的交互中学习可复用的操作。

sents.en: These memories guide a fixed base policy, which chooses primitive actions from the live interface (Figure 2 ).

A separate episode record 𝒯 \mathcal{T} retains evidence for task-end review. paragraphs.en: At task initialization, an LLM-based task compiler identifies the information to acquire and the outcomes to establish from the instruction. It represents them in a graph 𝒬 = ( V , E Q ) \mathcal{Q}=(V,E_{Q}) , whose nodes V V are requirements and whose edges E Q E_{Q} encode their dependencies. For each requirement q q , its dependencies R q R_{q} identify the requirements that supply its inputs, and an evidence rule V q V_{q} specifies how its result is recognized. An optional branch condition γ q \gamma_{q} specifies when the instruction requires q q . These dependencies concern task results rather than a prescribed sequence of GUI actions. The task-local state S t S_{t} records each requirement’s status, known values, and supporting evidence at step t t . Object bindings associate a value or outcome with its task entity, such as the event to which a meeting time belongs.
paragraphs.zh: 在任务初始化时，一个基于大语言模型的任务编译器从指令中识别需要获取的信息和需要确立的结果。 它将这些内容表示为图 𝒬 = ( V , E Q )，其中节点 V 表示需求，边 E Q 编码需求之间的依赖关系。 对于每个需求 q，其依赖集 R q 确定为它提供输入的需求，证据规则 V q 指定如何识别其结果。 可选的分支条件 γ q 指定指令何时需要 q。 这些依赖关系关注的是任务结果，而非预先规定的图形界面操作序列。 任务局部状态 S t 在步骤 t 记录每个需求的状态、已知取值和支持证据。 对象绑定将一个取值或结果与其任务实体关联起来，例如会议时间所属的事件。

paragraphs.en: Task Advancement State turns verified progress into an explicit representation of the remaining problem. Information already obtained is bound to the requirements that need it, and satisfied requirements are removed from the remaining work. We call this task reduction . We call the unfinished requirements with their available inputs the residual task . Completed requirements leave this view, while their results remain in S t S_{t} for later use. For example, Figure 2 assumes a departure time of 5 PM. Reading a driving duration of 3 h 18 min supplies the missing value for calculating arrival at 8:18 PM. The remaining goal is to send Susan that time. TAM thus carries the result of the route query into the messaging goal across the application change.

paragraphs.en: The first update can establish visible information and object bindings. The second evaluates the set 𝒱 t \mathcal{V}_{t} of outcome requirements implicated by the action or an explicit confirmation cue. Using the observation returned by the environment, TAM distinguishes three cases: text entered into a form is a draft, clicking Save is an attempt, and an appropriate confirmation supports a saved result. The accepted result then becomes available to dependent requirements. This keeps progress tied to observed effects while leaving action selection with the base policy.
paragraphs.zh: 第一次更新可以建立可见信息与对象绑定。 第二次更新评估由该动作或明确确认提示所牵涉的结果需求集合 𝒱 t \mathcal{V}_{t}。 利用环境返回的观察，TAM 区分三种情况：输入到表单中的文本是草稿，点击保存是一次尝试，而恰当的确认则支持已保存的结果。 被接受的结果随后可供依赖它的需求使用。 这使进度与观察到的效果保持关联，同时将动作选择留给基础策略。

paragraphs.en: A task-local Evidence Cache ℰ \mathcal{E} stores source images or crops linked to task information and its object bindings. When a requirement needs information whose source screen has left recent context, recalled evidence can restore its value or clarify which object it describes. Recalled images are identified as historical evidence. Current controls and coordinates come from the live screen.

paragraphs.en: Advancement supervision learns reusable operations from verified local results, including those within failed workflows. The challenge is both temporal and semantic: identify the productive interaction, then determine what it required and achieved.
paragraphs.zh: 进阶监督从经过验证的局部结果中学习可复用的操作，包括那些位于失败工作流中的结果。 这一挑战既是时间性的也是语义性的：先识别出有成效的交互，再确定它需要什么以及达成了什么。

paragraphs.en: Each advancement identifies a local result and a candidate segment of preceding interactions. When terminal evaluation nominates an outcome, it enters the same retrospective review. At task termination, an LLM-based reviewer examines the result and recorded actions and observations, including later evidence of confirmation or contradiction. It retains supported operations and selects the steps contributing to their navigation and information acquisition. Review evaluates each operation against the evidence for its local result, including when the larger task fails. TAM separates inputs needed before the retained interaction from information acquired within it. Only the former become the operation’s entry requirements. For example, a route query requires an origin and destination; the driving duration is acquired by the operation itself. This makes the learned query applicable to new routes whose duration the agent still needs to find.
paragraphs.zh: 每次进步都会识别一个局部结果以及前序交互中的一个候选片段。 当终止评估提名某个结果时，该结果同样进入回顾审查。 在任务终止时，一个基于 LLM 的审查者会检查结果以及记录下来的动作和观察，包括后来出现的证实或反驳的证据。 它保留有依据的操作，并选出有助于其导航和信息获取的步骤。 审查会根据每个操作局部结果的证据来评估该操作，即使整个任务失败时也是如此。 TAM 将保留交互之前所需的输入与在交互之中获取的信息区分开来。 只有前者成为该操作的入口要求。 例如，路线查询需要起点和终点；而行驶时长由操作本身获取。 这使得学到的查询可以适用于新的路线，而智能体仍需自行查找这些路线的行驶时长。

paragraphs.en: A supported segment yields an Advancement Operator
paragraphs.zh: 支持的片段会产生一个进阶算子

paragraphs.en: Its components are entry requirements R κ R_{\kappa} , expected advancement Δ κ \Delta_{\kappa} , verification condition V κ V_{\kappa} , object roles B κ B_{\kappa} , optional applicability conditions Γ κ \Gamma_{\kappa} , and reviewed GUI realizations 𝒜 κ \mathcal{A}_{\kappa} : recorded action sequences together with the interface conditions under which they were observed. Abstraction replaces instance-specific values with roles shared across the inputs, result, and verification target. For example, event details and the creation confirmation must refer to the same event. Concrete GUI entry conditions and action details belong to individual realizations. The persistent Advancement Operator Graph 𝒢 \mathcal{G} links each operator to its observed GUI realizations. This lets TAM reuse the same operation while checking each route against the current interface. To consolidate a new sample, TAM compares its input–result relation with the stored operators: compatible samples refine a shared description while retaining distinct GUI realizations. Otherwise, the sample forms a separate operator.
paragraphs.zh: 其组成部分包括进入条件 R κ R_{\kappa}、预期推进 Δ κ \Delta_{\kappa}、验证条件 V κ V_{\kappa}、对象角色 B κ B_{\kappa}、可选的适用条件 Γ κ \Gamma_{\kappa}，以及经过审核的 GUI 实现 𝒜 κ \mathcal{A}_{\kappa}：即所记录的动作序列连同观察到这些序列时的界面条件。 抽象将特定于实例的值替换为输入、结果与验证目标之间共享的角色。 例如，事件详情与创建确认必须指向同一事件。 具体的 GUI 进入条件与动作细节属于各个实现。 持久化的推进算子图 𝒢 \mathcal{G} 将每个算子与其观察到的 GUI 实现相关联。 这使得 TAM 能够复用同一操作，同时针对当前界面核查每条路径。 为整合新样本，TAM 将其输入–结果关系与已存储的算子进行比较：兼容的样本在保留各自不同 GUI 实现的同时细化共享描述。 否则，该样本会形成一个独立的算子。

paragraphs.en: An operation can remain useful across changes in its GUI implementation. TAM separates two questions: whether the operation supplies a needed result from available inputs, and whether the current interface supports a recorded route. TAM retrieves operators whose expected results and input roles match a frontier requirement. Among supported candidates, it considers both coverage of remaining requirements and the applicability and reliability of the stored GUI route. Selection retains a bounded set of alternatives across these two criteria, favoring additional requirement coverage. Appendices A.6 and A.10 specify matching, compatibility checks, and selection rules. When the required inputs are available and a stored GUI route passes the interface and reliability checks, the readout includes that route. Otherwise, a supported operator can still supply its required inputs, expected result, and verification cue, with missing inputs explicitly marked. Task knowledge therefore remains useful when a stored route needs adaptation. The actor uses this guidance to choose primitive actions from the current interface. Historical success guides the attempt; current observations determine whether the expected advancement is accepted. If no operator is relevant, ordinary execution continues with the task state and recent context.
paragraphs.zh: 一项操作可以在其 GUI 实现发生变化后仍然保持有用。 TAM 将两个问题区分开来：该操作是否能用可用输入产生所需结果，以及当前界面是否支持已记录的路径。 TAM 检索其预期结果和输入角色与某个前沿需求相匹配的算子。 在受支持的候选者中，它会同时考虑对剩余需求的覆盖程度，以及所存储 GUI 路径的适用性和可靠性。 选择会依据这两个标准保留一个有界的备选集合，并优先考虑更多的需求覆盖。 附录 A.6 和 A.10 规定了匹配、兼容性检查和选择规则。 当所需输入可用且某个已存储的 GUI 路径通过界面和可靠性检查时，读出内容会包含该路径。 否则，受支持的算子仍可提供其所需输入、预期结果和验证线索，缺失的输入会被明确标记。 因此，当已存储的路径需要调整时，任务知识仍然保持有用。 执行者利用这些指导从当前界面中选择基本动作。 历史成功引导尝试；当前观察决定是否接受预期的推进。 如果没有相关的算子，则按常规继续执行，依据任务状态和近期上下文进行。

paragraphs.en: ∗ The archived StructAgent and GUI-explorer accounting omits autonomous exploration and knowledge-base construction, so their lifecycle cost is a lower bound.
paragraphs.zh: ∗ 归档的 StructAgent 和 GUI-explorer 的统计未包含自主探索与知识库构建，因此其生命周期成本为下限。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate task completion on two benchmarks and lifecycle cost on MobileWorld. Component ablations measure the contribution of online state and persistent operators. We also examine whether earlier results remain usable and whether local review produces reliable learning material.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两个基准上评估任务完成情况，并在 MobileWorld 上评估生命周期成本。 组件消融实验衡量在线状态和持久算子的贡献。 我们还考察早期结果是否仍然可用，以及本地审查是否能产生可靠的学习材料。

paragraphs.en: MobileWorld GUI-only tests long-horizon tasks across a broad application suite, including workflows that span multiple apps ( Kong et al., 2026 ) . We use the GUI-only interaction setting with standard mobile actions. This setting stresses the preservation of information and results across application boundaries. SPA-Bench English Level 3 evaluates multi-stage workflows within individual smartphone applications at the benchmark’s highest difficulty tier ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . Following GUI-explorer, we study the single-app English Level 3 setting with Set-of-Mark (SoM) observations and GPT-4o ( Xie et al., 2025 ; OpenAI, 2024 ) . It complements MobileWorld by testing sustained interaction with real-world applications without requiring cross-app information transfer.
paragraphs.zh: MobileWorld 在广泛的应用套件上测试仅图形用户界面（GUI-only）的长程任务，包括跨多个应用的工作流程（Kong et al., 2026）。 我们使用仅图形用户界面的交互设置和标准移动操作。 该设置着重考验信息与结果在应用边界之间的保持。 SPA-Bench English Level 3 在该基准的最高难度层级上评估单个智能手机应用内的多阶段工作流程（Chen et al., 2025）。 遵循 GUI-explorer，我们研究单应用 English Level 3 设置，使用 Set-of-Mark（SoM）观测和 GPT-4o（Xie et al., 2025; OpenAI, 2024）。 它与 MobileWorld 互补，测试与真实应用的持续交互，而无需跨应用的信息传递。

paragraphs.en: Every MobileWorld method in Table 1 uses Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct and the same limit of 50 controller rounds ( Bai et al., 2025 ) . TAM builds persistent memory from interactions in the evaluation task sequence, without a separate application-exploration stage. Task Advancement State and Evidence Cache reset between tasks, reviewed operators remain available to subsequent tasks. Component ablations preserve the base policy, action interface, and interaction budget. On SPA-Bench, we use a task-specific budget of 2 ​ g i + 1 2g_{i}+1 rounds, where g i g_{i} is the reference human action count. The official evaluator scores the recorded trajectory after termination; it supplies no intermediate success feedback to the policy. Appendix B.3 specifies execution, memory, and the aggregation protocol.
paragraphs.zh: 表1中的每个MobileWorld方法均使用Qwen3-VL-32B-Instruct以及相同的50轮控制器轮数上限（Bai et al., 2025）。 TAM从评估任务序列中的交互构建持久记忆，无需单独的应用探索阶段。 任务推进状态和证据缓存在任务之间重置，而已审核的操作符对后续任务仍然可用。 组件消融实验保留了基础策略、动作接口和交互预算。 在SPA-Bench上，我们使用任务特定的2 g i + 1 2g_{i}+1轮预算，其中 g i g_{i} 是参考人类动作次数。 官方评估器在终止后对记录的轨迹进行评分；它不会向策略提供任何中间成功反馈。 附录B.3规定了执行、记忆和聚合协议。

paragraphs.en: Success is acceptance by the benchmark’s native evaluator and is reported for both benchmarks. We additionally report the following execution and cost metrics on MobileWorld. Steps averages controller rounds over all runs, including failures, and is interpreted jointly with success. A controller round is one externally counted action decision. Efficiency–Quality Area at 50 rounds (EQA@50) jointly rewards successful completion and fewer controller rounds, assigning zero credit to failures ( Wang et al., 2026 ) . Lifecycle Tokens per Solved Task (LTS) divides total model-token expenditure by solved tasks, including memory construction, execution, and failed attempts.

paragraphs.en: On MobileWorld, TAM achieves 34.2% success, improving on the strongest evaluated baseline by 5.1 percentage points (Table 1 ). Relative to the memory-free backbone, the gain is 22.2 points. Across all three app-count groups, TAM outperforms all four compared baselines (Table 3 ). Its advantage over ConAct is larger on the 62 multi-app tasks, where success reaches 32.3% versus 24.2% (+8.1 points), than on single-app tasks (+1.8 points). The larger multi-app gain supports TAM’s focus on sustaining execution across application boundaries. TAM also attains the highest EQA@50, 29.2%, and uses 20.6 controller rounds on average, showing that the advantage also holds when successful completion is rewarded for taking fewer rounds. TAM uses 0.771M lifecycle tokens per solved task, 38.7% below ConAct’s 1.257M. AWM is slightly cheaper at 0.720M, but completes 13.7% of tasks versus TAM’s 34.2%. TAM offers the strongest completion rate in this comparison at a lifecycle cost close to the cheapest evaluated memory method. This supports the practical value of organizing memory around established task results rather than increasing the interaction budget. On SPA-Bench English Level 3, TAM reaches 57.0% success, 3.3 percentage points above GUI-explorer’s reported 53.7% (Table 2 ). This is the highest result in the reported comparison. Together, the two benchmarks show that TAM’s benefits occur both in cross-app workflows with an open-source backbone and in difficult single-app tasks with GPT-4o.
paragraphs.zh: 在 MobileWorld 上，TAM 取得 34.2% 的成功率，比评估的最强基线提升 5.1 个百分点（表 1）。 相对于无记忆的骨干模型，提升为 22.2 个百分点。 在所有三个应用数量分组中，TAM 的表现均优于四个对比基线（表 3）。 相比 ConAct 的优势在 62 个多应用任务上更大，成功率达到 32.3% 对 24.2%（+8.1 个百分点），而在单应用任务上为 +1.8 个百分点。 更大的多应用增益支持了 TAM 对维持跨应用边界执行的关注。 TAM 还取得了最高的 EQA@50，为 29.2%，并且平均使用 20.6 个控制器轮次，表明当成功完成还奖励更少轮次时，该优势依然成立。 TAM 每个已解决任务使用 0.771M 生命周期 token，比 ConAct 的 1.257M 低 38.7%。 AWM 略微更便宜，为 0.720M，但只完成 13.7% 的任务，而 TAM 为 34.2%。 在此次比较中，TAM 以接近最便宜的受评估记忆方法的生命周期成本提供了最强的完成率。 这支持了围绕既定任务结果来组织记忆而非增加交互预算的实用价值。 在 SPA-Bench 英语 Level 3 上，TAM 达到 57.0% 的成功率，比 GUI-explorer 报告的 53.7% 高出 3.3 个百分点（表 2）。 这是所报告比较中的最高结果。 这两个基准共同表明，TAM 的收益既体现在使用开源骨干模型的跨应用工作流中，也体现在使用 GPT-4o 的困难单应用任务中。

paragraphs.en: To examine whether acquired information remains usable, we audit archived runs of tasks that require obtaining a value from the environment and using it in a later operation. The comparison covers the same 52 required values across 21 tasks for all five methods. Within each task, identification coverage is the fraction of required values explicitly and correctly stated in online outputs; target-use coverage is the fraction correctly used in their intended fields or objects. Averaging these rates equally across tasks, TAM achieves the highest observed coverage for both identification and target use (Figure 3 (a)).
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验获取到的信息是否仍然可用，我们审计了需要从环境中获取数值并在后续操作中使用它的任务的存档运行记录。 该比较覆盖了所有五种方法在 21 个任务中相同的 52 个所需数值。 在每个任务内，识别覆盖率是在线输出中明确且正确给出所需数值的比例；目标使用覆盖率是在预期字段或对象中正确使用这些数值的比例。 对这些比率在各任务间取同等平均后，TAM 在识别和目标使用两方面均取得了最高的观测覆盖率（图 3 (a)）。

paragraphs.en: We use a flat-state control to test the value of relating stored facts to pending requirements. The control retains fact storage and open requirements while removing prerequisite links and their action guidance. To compare the use of available information, we include all target fields in the paired runs whose required source inputs were visible to both agents. The nine eligible fields from five tasks are each assessed under two paired implementation revisions, giving 18 field instances. Over these instances, state availability measures the fraction with the correct value explicitly recorded in the actor’s state. paragraphs.en: Beyond the main benchmark comparisons, the appendix provides complementary evidence on information retention, state organization, local learning signals, experience reuse, and resource requirements. Appendix D.1 classifies all 117 MobileWorld GUI-only tasks and identifies 52 that require transferring acquired values to later operations, establishing the scope of our field-level diagnostics. Appendix D.2 shows that 95.1% of tracked values remain in state after ten decisions, compared with 57.6% in current XML or recent text, demonstrating sustained access beyond the immediate context. Appendix D.3 finds that TAM assembles all audited inputs before entry in 80% of operations, versus 40% for flat state, when both agents have encountered the required source information. This supports organizing acquired facts around pending operations. In matched tests of access to captured facts, Appendix D.4 reports 96.2% readout accuracy versus 80.8% for ordinary notes at similar input size. TAM also uses 37.3% fewer input tokens per readout than full textual history, combining accurate access with compact context. Appendix D.5 shows that local selection retains 88.3% of correct material versus 64.3% for success-only filtering, with 93.8% correctness among retained values, expanding the pool of reliable learning material. Appendix D.6 shows that 74.8% of audited failed executions containing verified local results contribute retained learning material. Recorded traces connect this material to guidance for later tasks, demonstrating the learning value of partial progress. Appendix D.7 reports 83.3% correctness when binding changed task values and 79.3% correct destination use in the respective field audits, supporting the adaptation of stored experience to new tasks. Finally, Appendix D.8 documents a compact resource footprint across the archived runs, with median shares of 5.7% of actor text for state and guidance and 1.7% of recorded tokens for additional calls.
paragraphs.zh: 除主要的基准测试对比之外，附录还提供了关于信息保留、状态组织、局部学习信号、经验复用以及资源需求的补充证据。 附录 D.1 对 MobileWorld 全部 117 个纯 GUI 任务进行了分类，并识别出 52 个需要将已获取的值迁移到后续操作中的任务，从而确立了我们的字段级诊断的范围。 附录 D.2 表明，在十个决策之后，95.1% 的被追踪值仍保留在状态中，而当前 XML 或近期文本中仅有 57.6%，证明了超出即时上下文之外的持续可访问性。 附录 D.3 发现，当两个智能体都已接触到所需的源信息时，TAM 在 80% 的操作中在进入前组装了全部被审计的输入，而扁平状态仅为 40%。 这支持围绕待处理操作来组织已获取的事实。 在对已捕获事实访问能力的匹配测试中，附录 D.4 报告了 96.2% 的读取准确率，而在相似输入规模下普通笔记为 80.8%。 TAM 每次读取所使用的输入 token 还比完整文本历史少 37.3%，将准确访问与紧凑上下文相结合。 附录 D.5 表明，局部选择保留了 88.3% 的正确材料，而仅基于成功的过滤为 64.3%，且保留值中的正确率为 93.8%，从而扩大了可靠学习材料的储备。 附录 D.6 表明，在被审计的包含已验证局部结果的失败执行中，74.8% 贡献了可保留的学习材料。 记录的轨迹将这些材料与后续任务的指导联系起来，展示了部分进展的学习价值。 附录 D.7 报告，在相应的字段审计中，绑定已变更任务值的正确率为 83.3%，目标使用正确率为 79.3%，支持将存储的经验适配到新任务。 最后，附录 D.8 记录了归档运行中的紧凑资源占用，其中状态与指导占智能体文本的中位比例为 5.7%，额外调用占记录 token 的中位比例为 1.7%。

sents.en: Beyond the main benchmark comparisons, the appendix provides complementary evidence on information retention, state organization, local learning signals, experience reuse, and resource requirements.

sents.en: Appendix D.3 finds that TAM assembles all audited inputs before entry in 80% of operations, versus 40% for flat state, when both agents have encountered the required source information.

paragraphs.en: Task Advancement Memory makes established results useful at two timescales. During execution, task reduction supplies acquired information to pending requirements and removes completed requirements. During learning, the interactions yield reusable operations whose entry inputs, outcome, and verification target remain aligned after abstraction. Across MobileWorld and SPA-Bench, TAM improves task completion, with ablations establishing the independent value of Advancement State and further gains from persistent operators. These findings support a task-centered foundation for GUI memory: accumulated progress makes the current problem more concrete, while productive interaction builds capabilities for future workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 任务推进记忆（Task Advancement Memory）使已有成果在两个时间尺度上发挥作用。 在执行期间，任务规约将已获取的信息提供给待满足的需求，并移除已完成的需求。 在学习期间，这些交互产生可复用的操作，其入口输入、结果和验证目标在抽象化之后仍保持一致。 在 MobileWorld 和 SPA-Bench 上，TAM 提升了任务完成率，消融实验确立了推进状态（Advancement State）的独立价值，以及持久化操作带来的进一步收益。 这些发现为以任务为中心的 GUI 记忆奠定了基础：累积的进展使当前问题更加具体，而富有成效的交互则为未来的工作流构建能力。

sents.en: Task Advancement Memory makes established results useful at two timescales.
sents.zh: 任务推进记忆（Task Advancement Memory）使已有成果在两个时间尺度上发挥作用。

sents.zh: 在 MobileWorld 和 SPA-Bench 上，TAM 提升了任务完成率，消融实验确立了推进状态（Advancement State）的独立价值，以及持久化操作带来的进一步收益。

paragraphs.en: TAM builds task state and reusable operators from observed results. The accuracy of this process depends on model-based interpretation of task requirements and GUI evidence, especially when outcome cues are ambiguous. Improving visual grounding and outcome verification can strengthen both online execution and experience learning.
paragraphs.zh: TAM 从观测结果中构建任务状态和可复用算子。 该过程的准确性取决于对任务需求和 GUI 证据的基于模型的解读，尤其是在结果线索模糊的情况下。 改进视觉定位和结果验证可以同时增强在线执行和经验学习。

sents.en: TAM builds task state and reusable operators from observed results.
sents.zh: TAM 从观测结果中构建任务状态和可复用算子。

sents.en: The accuracy of this process depends on model-based interpretation of task requirements and GUI evidence, especially when outcome cues are ambiguous.
sents.zh: 该过程的准确性取决于对任务需求和 GUI 证据的基于模型的解读，尤其是在结果线索模糊的情况下。

sents.en: Improving visual grounding and outcome verification can strengthen both online execution and experience learning.
sents.zh: 改进视觉定位和结果验证可以同时增强在线执行和经验学习。

paragraphs.en: Our evaluation focuses on MobileWorld GUI-only tasks and the English Level 3 subset of SPA-Bench, covering cross-application workflows and difficult single-application tasks on mobile devices. Extending this evaluation to web and desktop workflows would assess transfer across interface types.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的评估聚焦于 MobileWorld 的纯图形界面任务以及 SPA-Bench 的英语 Level 3 子集，涵盖跨应用工作流和移动设备上的高难度单应用任务。 将此评估扩展到网页和桌面工作流将能检验其在不同界面类型之间的迁移能力。

sents.en: Our evaluation focuses on MobileWorld GUI-only tasks and the English Level 3 subset of SPA-Bench, covering cross-application workflows and difficult single-application tasks on mobile devices.
sents.zh: 我们的评估聚焦于 MobileWorld 的纯图形界面任务以及 SPA-Bench 的英语 Level 3 子集，涵盖跨应用工作流和移动设备上的高难度单应用任务。

sents.en: Extending this evaluation to web and desktop workflows would assess transfer across interface types.
sents.zh: 将此评估扩展到网页和桌面工作流将能检验其在不同界面类型之间的迁移能力。

paragraphs.en: TAM’s persistent operators accumulate across the benchmark task sequences studied here. Longer task streams and repeated application updates introduce further requirements for maintaining relevant experience. The separation between an operation’s intended result and its GUI realizations provides a basis for studying adaptation as interfaces change. Future work can examine operator revision and retirement, together with their effects on retrieval quality and memory-maintenance cost.
paragraphs.zh: TAM 的持久操作符在本文所研究的基准任务序列中持续积累。 更长的任务流和反复的应用更新对维护相关经验提出了进一步的要求。 操作的预期结果与其 GUI 实现之间的分离，为研究界面变化时的适应提供了基础。 未来工作可以研究操作符的修订与退役，以及它们对检索质量和记忆维护成本的影响。

paragraphs.en: This appendix describes how TAM connects the requirements of a task to observed progress and reusable operations. We follow the execution order in Algorithm 1 : compile the requirements, maintain task advancement state, retrieve relevant evidence and operators, and review supported local operations for reuse. The same requirement and object identifiers connect these stages.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录介绍TAM如何将任务的需求与观察到的进展以及可复用的操作联系起来。 我们按照算法1中的执行顺序：编译需求、维护任务推进状态、检索相关证据与算子，并审查可复用的受支持的局部操作。 相同的需求标识符和对象标识符将这些阶段连接起来。

sents.en: This appendix describes how TAM connects the requirements of a task to observed progress and reusable operations.
sents.zh: 本附录介绍TAM如何将任务的需求与观察到的进展以及可复用的操作联系起来。

sents.en: We follow the execution order in Algorithm 1 : compile the requirements, maintain task advancement state, retrieve relevant evidence and operators, and review supported local operations for reuse.
sents.zh: 我们按照算法1中的执行顺序：编译需求、维护任务推进状态、检索相关证据与算子，并审查可复用的受支持的局部操作。

sents.en: The same requirement and object identifiers connect these stages.
sents.zh: 相同的需求标识符和对象标识符将这些阶段连接起来。

paragraphs.en: A requirement in 𝒬 \mathcal{Q} describes either information to acquire or an outcome to achieve. Its record contains a relation name, value type, object roles, prerequisite requirements R q R_{q} , and a verification condition V q V_{q} . Structured values also specify their required fields. An optional condition γ q \gamma_{q} identifies the branch in which the requirement applies. For example, an event record can contain its title, date, and time, while a notification requirement depends on that record and the recipient’s contact information. Dependencies describe the information consumed by an operation; the GUI route is chosen during execution.
paragraphs.zh: 𝒬 中的一个需求描述了要获取的信息或要达成的结果。 其记录包含一个关系名称、取值类型、对象角色、前置需求 R q R_{q} 以及一个验证条件 V q V_{q} 。 结构化取值还会指定其所需的字段。 可选条件 γ q \gamma_{q} 标识该需求所适用的分支。 例如，一条事件记录可以包含其标题、日期和时间，而一个通知需求则依赖于该记录以及接收方的联系信息。 依赖关系描述某个操作所消耗的信息；GUI 路由在执行期间选定。

sents.zh: 𝒬 中的一个需求描述了要获取的信息或要达成的结果。

paragraphs.en: The state S t S_{t} associates each requirement with its status, current bindings, and evidence references, as described in Section 3.1 . Bindings preserve the relation between a value and its object: an event time belongs to the specified event, and an address belongs to the specified recipient. Evidence references identify the observation step and saved source artifact. The implementation also records artifact digests so that a reused image retains its original identity.
paragraphs.zh: 状态 S t S_{t} 将每个需求与其状态、当前绑定以及证据引用关联起来，如第 3.1 节所述。 绑定保留值与其对象之间的关系：事件时间属于指定的事件，地址属于指定的收件人。 证据引用标识观察步骤和已保存的源工件。 实现还记录工件摘要，以便被复用的镜像保留其原始身份。

paragraphs.en: The Evidence Cache ℰ \mathcal{E} stores visual support for task-local facts. The persistent graph 𝒢 \mathcal{G} stores operators and their GUI realizations. An operator records its entry inputs, expected advancement, verification condition, object roles, and applicability conditions. Its realizations retain the corresponding action sequences and interface contexts. This separates the result an operation provides from the route used to obtain it. Task state and cached evidence reset at the task boundary; reviewed operators remain available to subsequent tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 证据缓存 ℰ \mathcal{E} 存储任务局部事实的视觉支撑信息。 持久化图 𝒢 \mathcal{G} 存储算子及其 GUI 实现方式。 算子记录其入口输入、预期进展、验证条件、对象角色以及适用条件。 算子的实现方式保留对应的动作序列和界面上下文。 这将操作所提供的结果与获取该结果所使用的路径分离开来。 任务状态与缓存证据在任务边界处重置；已审核的算子对后续任务保持可用。

paragraphs.en: At task start, the LLM-based compiler receives the natural-language instruction and proposes information and outcome requirements in JSON. It assigns types, names the necessary fields, and specifies which requirements supply inputs to each outcome. For a conditional request, it also represents the condition and its dependent requirement. Compilation operates on the instruction; it does not require advance access to the applications or their task-specific contents.
paragraphs.zh: 在任务开始时，基于大语言模型的编译器接收自然语言指令，并以 JSON 形式提出信息需求与结果需求。 它为需求分配类型，命名必要的字段，并指明哪些需求为每个结果提供输入。 对于条件式请求，它还会表示该条件及其所依赖的需求。 编译仅作用于指令本身，无需提前访问应用程序或其任务相关的内容。

sents.en: At task start, the LLM-based compiler receives the natural-language instruction and proposes information and outcome requirements in JSON.
sents.zh: 在任务开始时，基于大语言模型的编译器接收自然语言指令，并以 JSON 形式提出信息需求与结果需求。

sents.en: It assigns types, names the necessary fields, and specifies which requirements supply inputs to each outcome.
sents.zh: 它为需求分配类型，命名必要的字段，并指明哪些需求为每个结果提供输入。

sents.en: For a conditional request, it also represents the condition and its dependent requirement.
sents.zh: 对于条件式请求，它还会表示该条件及其所依赖的需求。

sents.en: Compilation operates on the instruction; it does not require advance access to the applications or their task-specific contents.
sents.zh: 编译仅作用于指令本身，无需提前访问应用程序或其任务相关的内容。

paragraphs.en: The implementation combines the proposal with schema normalization. This resolves requirement references, checks field types, and preserves prerequisite relations when bounding the graph size. The default target is 12 requirements; dependencies needed by a retained requirement are preserved. Explicit instruction values, such as a requested recipient, subject, or message, are kept as constraints on the corresponding outcome. They specify what the agent must achieve and are kept separate from observations of what it has achieved.
paragraphs.zh: 该实现将提议与模式规范化相结合。 它会解析需求引用、检查字段类型，并在限制图规模时保留前置条件关系。 默认目标为 12 条需求；被保留需求所依赖的依赖项会被保留。 显式指令值（例如请求的收件人、主题或消息）会作为对相应结果的约束被保留。 它们规定了智能体必须实现的目标，并与对智能体已实现内容的观察分开保存。

sents.en: The implementation combines the proposal with schema normalization.
sents.zh: 该实现将提议与模式规范化相结合。

sents.en: This resolves requirement references, checks field types, and preserves prerequisite relations when bounding the graph size.
sents.zh: 它会解析需求引用、检查字段类型，并在限制图规模时保留前置条件关系。

sents.en: The default target is 12 requirements; dependencies needed by a retained requirement are preserved.
sents.zh: 默认目标为 12 条需求；被保留需求所依赖的依赖项会被保留。

sents.en: Explicit instruction values, such as a requested recipient, subject, or message, are kept as constraints on the corresponding outcome.
sents.zh: 显式指令值（例如请求的收件人、主题或消息）会作为对相应结果的约束被保留。

sents.en: They specify what the agent must achieve and are kept separate from observations of what it has achieved.
sents.zh: 它们规定了智能体必须实现的目标，并与对智能体已实现内容的观察分开保存。

paragraphs.en: Consider the request to read an event’s details and notify a contact. The compiler separates the event information, the contact endpoint, and the notification outcome. If the task also asks for an independent numerical answer, that calculation is connected only to the outputs that use it. The resulting graph therefore preserves independent branches of the request instead of requiring every intermediate result before any outcome can be pursued.
paragraphs.zh: 考虑这样一个请求：读取事件的详细信息并通知联系人。 编译器将事件信息、联系人端点和通知结果分离开来。 如果任务还要求给出一个独立的数值答案，那么该计算只与使用它的输出相连。 因此，所得到的图保留了请求中相互独立的分支，而不必在任何结果可以被推进之前完成每一个中间结果。

sents.en: Consider the request to read an event’s details and notify a contact.
sents.zh: 考虑这样一个请求：读取事件的详细信息并通知联系人。

sents.en: The compiler separates the event information, the contact endpoint, and the notification outcome.
sents.zh: 编译器将事件信息、联系人端点和通知结果分离开来。

sents.en: If the task also asks for an independent numerical answer, that calculation is connected only to the outputs that use it.
sents.zh: 如果任务还要求给出一个独立的数值答案，那么该计算只与使用它的输出相连。

sents.en: The resulting graph therefore preserves independent branches of the request instead of requiring every intermediate result before any outcome can be pursued.
sents.zh: 因此，所得到的图保留了请求中相互独立的分支，而不必在任何结果可以被推进之前完成每一个中间结果。

paragraphs.en: The actor reports task-relevant observations alongside its action. Each observation update identifies a requirement, a value or structured fields, and the evidence that supports it. The update format distinguishes source information, derived values, visible drafts, collection coverage, and observed effects. These roles retain the difference between reading an event’s time, entering that time into a form, and observing a saved event. The runtime associates the proposed update with its requirement and source observation, checks the field structure, and updates the corresponding binding. Model-based extraction interprets the observed content; reference and schema checks preserve its association with the task and artifact.
paragraphs.zh: 执行者（actor）在执行动作的同时报告与任务相关的观察结果。 每次观察更新都会标识一个需求、一个值或结构化字段，以及支持它的证据。 更新格式区分源信息、派生值、可见草稿、收集覆盖范围和观察到的效果。 这些角色保留了读取事件时间、将该时间输入表单以及观察已保存事件之间的区别。 运行时将提议的更新与其需求和源观察关联起来，检查字段结构，并更新相应的绑定。 基于模型的提取负责解释观察到的内容；引用和模式检查则保持其与任务和工件的关联。

sents.en: The actor reports task-relevant observations alongside its action.
sents.zh: 执行者（actor）在执行动作的同时报告与任务相关的观察结果。

sents.en: Each observation update identifies a requirement, a value or structured fields, and the evidence that supports it.
sents.zh: 每次观察更新都会标识一个需求、一个值或结构化字段，以及支持它的证据。

sents.en: The update format distinguishes source information, derived values, visible drafts, collection coverage, and observed effects.
sents.zh: 更新格式区分源信息、派生值、可见草稿、收集覆盖范围和观察到的效果。

sents.en: These roles retain the difference between reading an event’s time, entering that time into a form, and observing a saved event.
sents.zh: 这些角色保留了读取事件时间、将该时间输入表单以及观察已保存事件之间的区别。

sents.en: The runtime associates the proposed update with its requirement and source observation, checks the field structure, and updates the corresponding binding.
sents.zh: 运行时将提议的更新与其需求和源观察关联起来，检查字段结构，并更新相应的绑定。

sents.en: Model-based extraction interprets the observed content; reference and schema checks preserve its association with the task and artifact.
sents.zh: 基于模型的提取负责解释观察到的内容；引用和模式检查则保持其与任务和工件的关联。

paragraphs.en: Source information can be established from the current observation. Relevant outcomes are assessed from the observation returned after an action, using the requirement’s verification condition. For instance, text visible in a message composer describes a draft; the sent-message view provides evidence about the resulting message. Both the content and its recipient matter when the task specifies them. The two updates in Eq. 3 thus use the observations already produced by the interaction loop.
paragraphs.zh: 来源信息可以从当前观测中确定。 相关结果依据需求中的验证条件，从执行动作后返回的观测中进行评估。 例如，消息编辑框中可见的文本描述的是一份草稿；已发送消息的视图则提供关于最终生成消息的证据。 当任务指定了内容及其接收者时，两者都很重要。 因此，公式 3 中的两次更新使用的是交互循环已经产生的观测。

sents.en: Source information can be established from the current observation.
sents.zh: 来源信息可以从当前观测中确定。

sents.en: Relevant outcomes are assessed from the observation returned after an action, using the requirement’s verification condition.
sents.zh: 相关结果依据需求中的验证条件，从执行动作后返回的观测中进行评估。

sents.en: For instance, text visible in a message composer describes a draft; the sent-message view provides evidence about the resulting message.
sents.zh: 例如，消息编辑框中可见的文本描述的是一份草稿；已发送消息的视图则提供关于最终生成消息的证据。

sents.en: Both the content and its recipient matter when the task specifies them.
sents.zh: 当任务指定了内容及其接收者时，两者都很重要。

sents.en: The two updates in Eq. 3 thus use the observations already produced by the interaction loop.
sents.zh: 因此，公式 3 中的两次更新使用的是交互循环已经产生的观测。

paragraphs.en: Structured requirements retain missing fields until they are supplied. Collections preserve observed members separately from evidence that the requested scope has been covered. Similarly, an absence claim refers to a particular source and search scope. Contradictory observations leave the affected requirement conflicted until further evidence resolves it. This keeps later inputs tied to the information that has been established.
paragraphs.zh: 结构化需求会保留缺失字段，直到这些字段被补充提供。 集合将已观察到的成员与已请求范围已被覆盖的证据分开保存。 类似地，缺失声明会指向特定的来源和搜索范围。 相互矛盾的观察会使受影响的需求保持冲突状态，直到进一步的证据解决该冲突。 这使得后续输入与已建立的信息保持关联。

sents.en: Structured requirements retain missing fields until they are supplied.
sents.zh: 结构化需求会保留缺失字段，直到这些字段被补充提供。

sents.en: Collections preserve observed members separately from evidence that the requested scope has been covered.
sents.zh: 集合将已观察到的成员与已请求范围已被覆盖的证据分开保存。

sents.en: Similarly, an absence claim refers to a particular source and search scope.
sents.zh: 类似地，缺失声明会指向特定的来源和搜索范围。

sents.en: Contradictory observations leave the affected requirement conflicted until further evidence resolves it.
sents.zh: 相互矛盾的观察会使受影响的需求保持冲突状态，直到进一步的证据解决该冲突。

sents.en: This keeps later inputs tied to the information that has been established.
sents.zh: 这使得后续输入与已建立的信息保持关联。

paragraphs.en: The actor receives the established bindings and a requirement readout that distinguishes available inputs from missing inputs. An input shared by several requirements is referenced from the same state record. This is the implementation of the residual-task representation described in Section 3.2 : completed requirements no longer constitute pending work, while their values remain available to their consumers. The frontier F t F_{t} identifies unresolved requirements whose dependencies and branch conditions are satisfied.
paragraphs.zh: 执行器接收已建立的绑定以及一份需求读取结果，该结果将可用输入与缺失输入区分开来。 被多个需求共享的输入从同一条状态记录中引用。 这是 3.2 节所述残余任务表示的实现：已完成的需求不再构成待办工作，同时其取值仍可供其消费者使用。 前沿 F_{t} 标识出其依赖与分支条件均已满足的未解决需求。

sents.en: The actor receives the established bindings and a requirement readout that distinguishes available inputs from missing inputs.
sents.zh: 执行器接收已建立的绑定以及一份需求读取结果，该结果将可用输入与缺失输入区分开来。

sents.en: An input shared by several requirements is referenced from the same state record.
sents.zh: 被多个需求共享的输入从同一条状态记录中引用。

sents.en: This is the implementation of the residual-task representation described in Section 3.2 : completed requirements no longer constitute pending work, while their values remain available to their consumers.
sents.zh: 这是 3.2 节所述残余任务表示的实现：已完成的需求不再构成待办工作，同时其取值仍可供其消费者使用。

sents.en: The frontier F t F_{t} identifies unresolved requirements whose dependencies and branch conditions are satisfied.
sents.zh: 前沿 F_{t} 标识出其依赖与分支条件均已满足的未解决需求。

paragraphs.en: In the event example, reading the event details supplies the notification’s content. After the contact endpoint is established, the notification has its required inputs. The actor can proceed using those values even after leaving the source applications. The readout organizes the next decision; it does not issue an action or replace the original task instruction. TAM’s full-method configuration leaves primitive action selection to the base policy.
paragraphs.zh: 在事件示例中，读取事件详情为通知提供了内容。 建立联系人端点后，通知就具备了所需的输入。 即使离开源应用程序，智能体仍可以使用这些值继续操作。 读出用于组织下一步决策；它不会发出动作，也不会取代原始任务指令。 TAM 的完整方法配置将基本动作的选择留给基础策略处理。

sents.en: In the event example, reading the event details supplies the notification’s content.
sents.zh: 在事件示例中，读取事件详情为通知提供了内容。

sents.en: After the contact endpoint is established, the notification has its required inputs.
sents.zh: 建立联系人端点后，通知就具备了所需的输入。

sents.en: The actor can proceed using those values even after leaving the source applications.
sents.zh: 即使离开源应用程序，智能体仍可以使用这些值继续操作。

sents.en: The readout organizes the next decision; it does not issue an action or replace the original task instruction.
sents.zh: 读出用于组织下一步决策；它不会发出动作，也不会取代原始任务指令。

sents.en: TAM’s full-method configuration leaves primitive action selection to the base policy.
sents.zh: TAM 的完整方法配置将基本动作的选择留给基础策略处理。

paragraphs.en: A cache entry links a saved screenshot or crop to the accepted relation, object binding, and source step. The cache is queried when a current requirement needs information whose source is no longer represented in the actor’s recent visual context. Selection follows the requirement’s input dependencies and matches the corresponding bindings. If several facts come from the same image, that image is attached once.
paragraphs.zh: 缓存条目将保存的截图或裁剪图像与已接受的关系、对象绑定和来源步骤关联起来。 当当前需求需要其来源已不再出现在智能体近期视觉上下文中的信息时，会查询缓存。 选择遵循需求的输入依赖关系，并匹配相应的绑定。 如果多个事实来自同一张图像，该图像只附加一次。

sents.en: A cache entry links a saved screenshot or crop to the accepted relation, object binding, and source step.
sents.zh: 缓存条目将保存的截图或裁剪图像与已接受的关系、对象绑定和来源步骤关联起来。

sents.en: The cache is queried when a current requirement needs information whose source is no longer represented in the actor’s recent visual context.
sents.zh: 当当前需求需要其来源已不再出现在智能体近期视觉上下文中的信息时，会查询缓存。

sents.en: Selection follows the requirement’s input dependencies and matches the corresponding bindings.
sents.zh: 选择遵循需求的输入依赖关系，并匹配相应的绑定。

sents.en: If several facts come from the same image, that image is attached once.
sents.zh: 如果多个事实来自同一张图像，该图像只附加一次。

paragraphs.en: The implementation forms a packet covering the required source evidence within a limit of three recalled images. Evidence already present in the actor context contributes to that coverage. Each recalled image is marked as a past observation and supplied with a reference identifier. When the actor reads a value from it, the observation update cites that identifier. The resulting value follows the ordinary state-update path. Current control locations and coordinates are grounded in the live observation.
paragraphs.zh: 该实现将所需的源证据打包成一个包，召回图像的数量上限为三张。 智能体上下文中已有的证据也计入该覆盖范围。 每张召回的图像都被标记为过去的观察，并附带一个引用标识符。 当智能体从中读取一个值时，观察更新会引用该标识符。 所得的值遵循普通的状态更新路径。 当前的控制位置和坐标以实时观察为依据。

sents.en: The implementation forms a packet covering the required source evidence within a limit of three recalled images.
sents.zh: 该实现将所需的源证据打包成一个包，召回图像的数量上限为三张。

sents.en: Evidence already present in the actor context contributes to that coverage.
sents.zh: 智能体上下文中已有的证据也计入该覆盖范围。

sents.en: Each recalled image is marked as a past observation and supplied with a reference identifier.
sents.zh: 每张召回的图像都被标记为过去的观察，并附带一个引用标识符。

sents.en: When the actor reads a value from it, the observation update cites that identifier.
sents.zh: 当智能体从中读取一个值时，观察更新会引用该标识符。

sents.en: The resulting value follows the ordinary state-update path.
sents.zh: 所得的值遵循普通的状态更新路径。

sents.en: Current control locations and coordinates are grounded in the live observation.
sents.zh: 当前的控制位置和坐标以实时观察为依据。

paragraphs.en: Cache selection does not invoke another model. The selected images enter the ordinary actor call, where their visual tokens are included in the cost. If no matching packet is available, execution proceeds with the current observation, recent history, and task state.
paragraphs.zh: 缓存选择不会调用另一个模型。 被选中的图像会进入普通的智能体调用，其视觉令牌计入成本。 如果没有可用的匹配数据包，执行将继续使用当前观测、近期历史和任务状态进行。

sents.en: Cache selection does not invoke another model.
sents.zh: 缓存选择不会调用另一个模型。

sents.en: The selected images enter the ordinary actor call, where their visual tokens are included in the cost.
sents.zh: 被选中的图像会进入普通的智能体调用，其视觉令牌计入成本。

sents.en: If no matching packet is available, execution proceeds with the current observation, recent history, and task state.
sents.zh: 如果没有可用的匹配数据包，执行将继续使用当前观测、近期历史和任务状态进行。

paragraphs.en: An accepted advancement records the affected requirement, its bindings, supporting evidence, and the preceding interaction segment. This initial segment retains context before the use of relevant inputs. It is a candidate for review: some of its interactions may be navigation, repeated attempts, or work unrelated to the established result.
paragraphs.zh: 一条被接受的推进记录会记载受影响的需求、其绑定、支持性证据以及前导的交互片段。 这一初始片段保留了使用相关输入之前的上下文。 它是待审查的候选对象：其中的一些交互可能是导航、重复尝试或与既定结果无关的工作。

sents.en: An accepted advancement records the affected requirement, its bindings, supporting evidence, and the preceding interaction segment.
sents.zh: 一条被接受的推进记录会记载受影响的需求、其绑定、支持性证据以及前导的交互片段。

sents.en: This initial segment retains context before the use of relevant inputs.
sents.zh: 这一初始片段保留了使用相关输入之前的上下文。

sents.en: It is a candidate for review: some of its interactions may be navigation, repeated attempts, or work unrelated to the established result.
sents.zh: 它是待审查的候选对象：其中的一些交互可能是导航、重复尝试或与既定结果无关的工作。

paragraphs.en: At task end, the reviewer receives the candidates, their recorded actions, the result observations, and available later evidence. It decides whether each local result is supported, selects the steps to retain, and cites the supporting artifacts. Later observations can confirm the result or reveal a reversal or object mismatch. Terminal success can nominate an outcome candidate for review, it does not replace the local evidence judgment. The independent outcome-quality audit excludes such evaluator-nominated candidates (Appendix D.5 ). Correctly reading an event remains a useful operation when a later notification fails; a successful task can likewise contain unproductive attempts that need not enter its reusable operation.
paragraphs.zh: 任务结束时，审核者会收到候选结果、其记录的操作、结果观测结果以及后续可用的证据。 它判断每个局部结果是否得到支持，选择要保留的步骤，并引用支持的工件。 后续的观测结果可以确认该结果，或揭示逆转或对象不匹配。 终端成功可以提名一个结果候选进入审核，但它不能取代局部证据判断。 独立的结果质量审计会排除这类由评估者提名的候选（附录 D.5）。 当后续通知失败时，正确读取事件仍然是一项有用的操作；同样，一个成功的任务也可能包含徒劳的尝试，这些尝试无需进入其可复用操作中。

sents.en: At task end, the reviewer receives the candidates, their recorded actions, the result observations, and available later evidence.
sents.zh: 任务结束时，审核者会收到候选结果、其记录的操作、结果观测结果以及后续可用的证据。

sents.en: It decides whether each local result is supported, selects the steps to retain, and cites the supporting artifacts.
sents.zh: 它判断每个局部结果是否得到支持，选择要保留的步骤，并引用支持的工件。

sents.en: Later observations can confirm the result or reveal a reversal or object mismatch.
sents.zh: 后续的观测结果可以确认该结果，或揭示逆转或对象不匹配。

sents.en: Terminal success can nominate an outcome candidate for review, it does not replace the local evidence judgment.
sents.zh: 终端成功可以提名一个结果候选进入审核，但它不能取代局部证据判断。

sents.en: The independent outcome-quality audit excludes such evaluator-nominated candidates (Appendix D.5 ).
sents.zh: 独立的结果质量审计会排除这类由评估者提名的候选（附录 D.5）。

sents.en: Correctly reading an event remains a useful operation when a later notification fails; a successful task can likewise contain unproductive attempts that need not enter its reusable operation.
sents.zh: 当后续通知失败时，正确读取事件仍然是一项有用的操作；同样，一个成功的任务也可能包含徒劳的尝试，这些尝试无需进入其可复用操作中。

paragraphs.en: TAM saves the accepted task facts available before each step. Once the reviewer selects a segment, the snapshot at its retained start identifies which inputs were already available. Changes within the segment identify information acquired by the operation itself. This distinction determines R κ R_{\kappa} : a value first obtained inside the retained segment is an internal result, rather than an input required before the operation starts. If review chooses a later start, the corresponding later snapshot supplies its entry state. The implementation preserves the navigation and information-acquisition steps needed to support the selected local result.
paragraphs.zh: TAM 保存每一步之前可用的已接受任务事实。 一旦审阅者选定一个片段，其保留起点处的快照即可识别哪些输入已经可用。 片段内的变更可识别由该操作自身获取的信息。 这一区别决定了 R κ R_{\kappa}：在保留片段内首次获得的值是内部结果，而非操作开始前所需的输入。 如果审阅选择了较晚的起点，则对应的较晚快照提供其进入状态。 该实现保留支持所选局部结果所需的导航和信息获取步骤。

sents.en: TAM saves the accepted task facts available before each step.
sents.zh: TAM 保存每一步之前可用的已接受任务事实。

sents.en: Once the reviewer selects a segment, the snapshot at its retained start identifies which inputs were already available.
sents.zh: 一旦审阅者选定一个片段，其保留起点处的快照即可识别哪些输入已经可用。

sents.en: Changes within the segment identify information acquired by the operation itself.
sents.zh: 片段内的变更可识别由该操作自身获取的信息。

sents.en: This distinction determines R κ R_{\kappa} : a value first obtained inside the retained segment is an internal result, rather than an input required before the operation starts.
sents.zh: 这一区别决定了 R κ R_{\kappa}：在保留片段内首次获得的值是内部结果，而非操作开始前所需的输入。

sents.en: If review chooses a later start, the corresponding later snapshot supplies its entry state.
sents.zh: 如果审阅选择了较晚的起点，则对应的较晚快照提供其进入状态。

sents.en: The implementation preserves the navigation and information-acquisition steps needed to support the selected local result.
sents.zh: 该实现保留支持所选局部结果所需的导航和信息获取步骤。

paragraphs.en: For example, a segment that opens a calendar and reads an event can learn an operation for acquiring event details. A subsequent segment that starts with those details and sends a notification can learn an operation that consumes them. The second operation’s inputs should not be assigned to the first merely because both appear in the same completed workflow. Conversely, reviewing a segment from a later starting point must use the information available at that point, rather than the task’s final state.
paragraphs.zh: 例如，一个打开日历并读取事件的片段可以学习一个获取事件详情的操作。 后续以这些详情为起点并发送通知的片段可以学习一个消费这些详情的操作。 第二个操作的输入不应仅仅因为两者出现在同一个已完成的工作流中就被分配给第一个操作。 反之，从较晚的起点回看某个片段时，必须使用该时点可用的信息，而不是任务的最终状态。

sents.en: For example, a segment that opens a calendar and reads an event can learn an operation for acquiring event details.
sents.zh: 例如，一个打开日历并读取事件的片段可以学习一个获取事件详情的操作。

sents.en: A subsequent segment that starts with those details and sends a notification can learn an operation that consumes them.
sents.zh: 后续以这些详情为起点并发送通知的片段可以学习一个消费这些详情的操作。

sents.en: The second operation’s inputs should not be assigned to the first merely because both appear in the same completed workflow.
sents.zh: 第二个操作的输入不应仅仅因为两者出现在同一个已完成的工作流中就被分配给第一个操作。

sents.en: Conversely, reviewing a segment from a later starting point must use the information available at that point, rather than the task’s final state.
sents.zh: 反之，从较晚的起点回看某个片段时，必须使用该时点可用的信息，而不是任务的最终状态。

paragraphs.en: For a supported segment, the reviewer provides a short description of the entry inputs, local result, and reusable method. It replaces task-specific values with object roles and compares the input–result relation with nearby stored operators. Compatible samples refine one operator while preserving their individual GUI realizations. Materially different inputs or outcomes produce separate operators. Different names, dates, or layouts alone do not require a separate semantic operation.
paragraphs.zh: 对于一个受支持的片段，审阅者会对条目的输入、局部结果以及可复用的方法提供一段简短描述。 它用对象角色替换任务特定的值，并将输入与结果的关系和邻近存储的算子进行比较。 兼容的样本会精炼同一个算子，同时保留各自独立的 GUI 实现。 实质上不同的输入或结果会产生独立的算子。 仅凭不同的名称、日期或布局并不需要单独的语义操作。

sents.en: For a supported segment, the reviewer provides a short description of the entry inputs, local result, and reusable method.
sents.zh: 对于一个受支持的片段，审阅者会对条目的输入、局部结果以及可复用的方法提供一段简短描述。

sents.en: It replaces task-specific values with object roles and compares the input–result relation with nearby stored operators.
sents.zh: 它用对象角色替换任务特定的值，并将输入与结果的关系和邻近存储的算子进行比较。

sents.en: Compatible samples refine one operator while preserving their individual GUI realizations.
sents.zh: 兼容的样本会精炼同一个算子，同时保留各自独立的 GUI 实现。

sents.en: Materially different inputs or outcomes produce separate operators.
sents.zh: 实质上不同的输入或结果会产生独立的算子。

sents.en: Different names, dates, or layouts alone do not require a separate semantic operation.
sents.zh: 仅凭不同的名称、日期或布局并不需要单独的语义操作。

paragraphs.en: For the route query in Figure 2 , the entry snapshot contains Orlando and Miami as the origin and destination. The driving duration is absent at entry and is obtained from the route-result screen. Abstraction replaces the two locations with origin and destination roles. The operator requires those roles, returns their driving duration, and checks that the displayed route uses the requested transportation type. Its recorded realization is Maps → \rightarrow route query → \rightarrow route result. The duration remains the result to obtain in a new task, rather than a prerequisite copied from the completed source trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 对于图2中的路线查询，入口快照中包含奥兰多和迈阿密作为出发地和目的地。 驾驶时长在入口处不存在，需从路线结果页面获取。 抽象将这两个地点替换为出发地和目的地角色。 该操作符需要这些角色，返回它们的驾驶时长，并检查所显示的路线是否使用了请求的交通方式。 其记录的实现为 Maps → \rightarrow 路线查询 → \rightarrow 路线结果。 该时长仍是在新任务中待获取的结果，而不是从已完成的源轨迹中复制的先决条件。

sents.en: For the route query in Figure 2 , the entry snapshot contains Orlando and Miami as the origin and destination.
sents.zh: 对于图2中的路线查询，入口快照中包含奥兰多和迈阿密作为出发地和目的地。

sents.en: The driving duration is absent at entry and is obtained from the route-result screen.
sents.zh: 驾驶时长在入口处不存在，需从路线结果页面获取。

sents.en: Abstraction replaces the two locations with origin and destination roles.
sents.zh: 抽象将这两个地点替换为出发地和目的地角色。

sents.en: The operator requires those roles, returns their driving duration, and checks that the displayed route uses the requested transportation type.
sents.zh: 该操作符需要这些角色，返回它们的驾驶时长，并检查所显示的路线是否使用了请求的交通方式。

sents.en: Its recorded realization is Maps → \rightarrow route query → \rightarrow route result.
sents.zh: 其记录的实现为 Maps → \rightarrow 路线查询 → \rightarrow 路线结果。

sents.en: The duration remains the result to obtain in a new task, rather than a prerequisite copied from the completed source trajectory.
sents.zh: 该时长仍是在新任务中待获取的结果，而不是从已完成的源轨迹中复制的先决条件。

paragraphs.en: The stored record links this description to the retained steps and evidence. The expected result and verification condition refer to the same object roles as the inputs. The graph can therefore preserve an operation such as creating an event from given details while retaining different observed routes through the calendar interface. New evidence refines the shared description while preserving each observed route.
paragraphs.zh: 存储的记录将该描述与保留的步骤和证据关联起来。 预期结果和验证条件引用与输入相同的对象角色。 因此，该图可以保留诸如根据给定详情创建事件之类的操作，同时保留通过日历界面的不同观察到的路径。 新的证据在保留每条观察到的路径的同时完善共享描述。

sents.en: The stored record links this description to the retained steps and evidence.
sents.zh: 存储的记录将该描述与保留的步骤和证据关联起来。

sents.en: The expected result and verification condition refer to the same object roles as the inputs.
sents.zh: 预期结果和验证条件引用与输入相同的对象角色。

sents.en: The graph can therefore preserve an operation such as creating an event from given details while retaining different observed routes through the calendar interface.
sents.zh: 因此，该图可以保留诸如根据给定详情创建事件之类的操作，同时保留通过日历界面的不同观察到的路径。

sents.en: New evidence refines the shared description while preserving each observed route.
sents.zh: 新的证据在保留每条观察到的路径的同时完善共享描述。

paragraphs.en: Retrieval begins with the remaining requirements and their available inputs. TAM compares candidate operators with the needed result and checks whether their input roles and applicability conditions fit the current task. It then assesses each stored realization against the current application and interface context. These are the task-relevance and GUI-compatibility questions introduced in Section 3.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 检索从剩余的需求及其可用输入开始。 TAM 将候选算子与所需结果进行比较，并检查它们的输入角色和适用性条件是否符合当前任务。 然后它会针对当前的应用程序和界面上下文评估每个已存储的实现。 这些正是第 3.4 节中引入的任务相关性和 GUI 兼容性问题。

sents.en: Retrieval begins with the remaining requirements and their available inputs.
sents.zh: 检索从剩余的需求及其可用输入开始。

sents.en: TAM compares candidate operators with the needed result and checks whether their input roles and applicability conditions fit the current task.
sents.zh: TAM 将候选算子与所需结果进行比较，并检查它们的输入角色和适用性条件是否符合当前任务。

sents.en: It then assesses each stored realization against the current application and interface context.
sents.zh: 然后它会针对当前的应用程序和界面上下文评估每个已存储的实现。

sents.en: These are the task-relevance and GUI-compatibility questions introduced in Section 3.4 .
sents.zh: 这些正是第 3.4 节中引入的任务相关性和 GUI 兼容性问题。

paragraphs.en: The readout includes the operation’s required inputs, expected advancement, and verification cue. When a realization fits the live interface, it also includes the corresponding route. Otherwise, the semantic operation still describes a useful result and how to recognize it, while the actor chooses a route from the current screen. Candidate selection retains a bounded set of relevant operations and avoids filling the context with equivalent routes. The retrieved-memory budget applies to this operator readout; task state and recent observations have their own context limits.
paragraphs.zh: 该读出内容包括该操作所需的输入、预期推进方式以及验证提示。 当一个实现与当前活动界面匹配时，读出内容还会包括对应的路由。 否则，语义操作仍会描述一个有用的结果以及如何识别它，而执行者则从当前屏幕中选择一条路由。 候选选择会保留一组有界的相关操作，避免用等价的路由填满上下文。 检索记忆的预算适用于此操作符读出；任务状态和近期观察有各自的上下文限制。

sents.en: The readout includes the operation’s required inputs, expected advancement, and verification cue.
sents.zh: 该读出内容包括该操作所需的输入、预期推进方式以及验证提示。

sents.en: When a realization fits the live interface, it also includes the corresponding route.
sents.zh: 当一个实现与当前活动界面匹配时，读出内容还会包括对应的路由。

sents.en: Otherwise, the semantic operation still describes a useful result and how to recognize it, while the actor chooses a route from the current screen.
sents.zh: 否则，语义操作仍会描述一个有用的结果以及如何识别它，而执行者则从当前屏幕中选择一条路由。

sents.en: Candidate selection retains a bounded set of relevant operations and avoids filling the context with equivalent routes.
sents.zh: 候选选择会保留一组有界的相关操作，避免用等价的路由填满上下文。

sents.en: The retrieved-memory budget applies to this operator readout; task state and recent observations have their own context limits.
sents.zh: 检索记忆的预算适用于此操作符读出；任务状态和近期观察有各自的上下文限制。

paragraphs.en: Applying an operator uses the current task’s bindings. Historical task values remain part of the source record, while the actor grounds the present action on the live interface. The expected advancement becomes an established requirement only when current observations support it. The same state-update process therefore connects learning from one task with verification in the next.
paragraphs.zh: 应用一个操作符时使用当前任务的绑定。 历史任务的取值仍保留在来源记录中，而智能体则依据实时界面来确定当下动作的基础。 只有当当前的观察结果予以支持时，预期的推进才会成为既定的要求。 因此，同一状态更新过程将从一个任务中的学习与下一个任务中的验证连接起来。

sents.en: Applying an operator uses the current task’s bindings.
sents.zh: 应用一个操作符时使用当前任务的绑定。

sents.en: Historical task values remain part of the source record, while the actor grounds the present action on the live interface.
sents.zh: 历史任务的取值仍保留在来源记录中，而智能体则依据实时界面来确定当下动作的基础。

sents.en: The expected advancement becomes an established requirement only when current observations support it.
sents.zh: 只有当当前的观察结果予以支持时，预期的推进才会成为既定的要求。

sents.en: The same state-update process therefore connects learning from one task with verification in the next.
sents.zh: 因此，同一状态更新过程将从一个任务中的学习与下一个任务中的验证连接起来。

paragraphs.en: Table 5 summarizes the inputs and outputs of the implementation’s model calls. Requirements, observation references, and retained step identifiers provide the common structure across calls. The actor also maintains a concise execution summary containing findings, attempted routes, and remaining work alongside the structured task state.
paragraphs.zh: 表5总结了该实现中模型调用的输入与输出。 需求、观察引用以及保留的步骤标识符为各次调用提供了共同的结构。 智能体还在结构化任务状态之外维护一份简明的执行摘要，其中包含发现、已尝试的路径和剩余工作。

sents.zh: 表5总结了该实现中模型调用的输入与输出。

sents.en: Requirements, observation references, and retained step identifiers provide the common structure across calls.
sents.zh: 需求、观察引用以及保留的步骤标识符为各次调用提供了共同的结构。

sents.en: The actor also maintains a concise execution summary containing findings, attempted routes, and remaining work alongside the structured task state.
sents.zh: 智能体还在结构化任务状态之外维护一份简明的执行摘要，其中包含发现、已尝试的路径和剩余工作。

paragraphs.en: Task compilation occurs at initialization, acting follows the environment’s decision loop, and retrospective review occurs after termination. The cache and the organization of available and missing inputs introduce no separate model calls. Model-cost accounting includes compilation, acting, triggered extraction, format repair, and retrospective review, together with the input tokens of recalled images. The benchmark settings and context budgets are reported in Appendix B ; Appendix D.8 analyzes the observed allocation of inference and actor context.
paragraphs.zh: 任务编译发生在初始化阶段，执行遵循环境的决策循环，回顾性评审则在终止之后进行。 缓存以及可用输入与缺失输入的组织不会引入额外的模型调用。 模型成本核算包括编译、执行、触发的抽取、格式修复和回顾性评审，并连同被召回图像的输入 token 一起计算。 基准测试设置与上下文预算报告见附录 B；附录 D.8 分析了所观测到的推理与智能体上下文的分配情况。

sents.en: Task compilation occurs at initialization, acting follows the environment’s decision loop, and retrospective review occurs after termination.
sents.zh: 任务编译发生在初始化阶段，执行遵循环境的决策循环，回顾性评审则在终止之后进行。

sents.en: The cache and the organization of available and missing inputs introduce no separate model calls.
sents.zh: 缓存以及可用输入与缺失输入的组织不会引入额外的模型调用。

sents.en: The benchmark settings and context budgets are reported in Appendix B ; Appendix D.8 analyzes the observed allocation of inference and actor context.
sents.zh: 基准测试设置与上下文预算报告见附录 B；附录 D.8 分析了所观测到的推理与智能体上下文的分配情况。

paragraphs.en: The compiler returns a JSON object with a goal_slots list. Each requirement has a stable schema name and a goal_kind : resource denotes information to obtain, and done denotes an observable GUI effect. The optional type and required_fields specify its value structure; requires names prerequisite requirements. consumption_role distinguishes a target endpoint, rendered content, decision input, lookup key, attachment, or verification target. entity_pattern and retrieval_cues describe the object and where to seek it. A conditional requirement names its branch_predicate ; alternative decision requirements can also name one another through alternative_to and specify condition_polarity . effect_constraints preserves the task’s required recipient, content, attachments, and fields to be checked at completion.
paragraphs.zh: 编译器返回一个包含 goal_slots 列表的 JSON 对象。 每个需求都有一个稳定的模式名和一个 goal_kind：resource 表示需要获取的信息，done 表示一个可观察的图形界面效果。 可选的 type 和必填的 required_fields 指定其取值结构；requires 用于命名前置需求。consumption_role 用于区分目标端点、渲染内容、决策输入、查找键、附件或验证目标。entity_pattern 和 retrieval_cues 描述该对象以及去哪里寻找它。 条件需求会命名其 branch_predicate；可替代的决策需求也可以通过 alternative_to 相互命名并指定 condition_polarity。effect_constraints 保留任务要求的接收者、内容、附件以及需要在完成时检查的字段。

sents.en: The compiler returns a JSON object with a goal_slots list.
sents.zh: 编译器返回一个包含 goal_slots 列表的 JSON 对象。

paragraphs.en: A stored binding records schema , type , value_norm , and state ; entity_key identifies its object, while evidence_ref and source_step_id retain the supporting artifact and source step.
paragraphs.zh: 存储的绑定会记录 schema、type、value_norm 和 state；entity_key 标识其对象，而 evidence_ref 和 source_step_id 则保留支持的工件和来源步骤。

paragraphs.en: Each update names an op , the displayed schema , a scalar value or structured fields , an evidence_role , and a short evidence_text . The roles are source , derived , draft , coverage , and effect . A recalled-image update additionally cites the displayed reference_evidence_id . These are proposals: the runtime associates them with the task requirement and recorded observation. An outcome-extraction call returns an observations list with schema , evidence_ref , evidence , and fields . Its parser admits only listed requirement names, the current post-action reference, and a nonempty visible witness.
paragraphs.zh: 每次更新都会命名一个操作、所显示的模式、一个标量值或结构化字段、一个 evidence_role，以及一段简短的 evidence_text。 这些角色是 source、derived、draft、coverage 和 effect。 召回图像的更新还会引用所显示的 reference_evidence_id。 这些是提议：运行时会将它们与任务需求和记录的观察相关联。 结果提取调用会返回一个观察列表，其中包含模式、evidence_ref、证据和字段。 其解析器只接受列出的需求名称、当前动作后的引用，以及非空且可见的见证内容。

paragraphs.en: The following excerpts are taken verbatim from the prompts used in our implementation; the task-specific JSON packet and images follow the instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 以下摘录逐字取自我们实现中所使用的提示词；任务特定的 JSON 数据包和图像附在指令之后。

paragraphs.en: “Infer the smallest set of goal slots required to determine task completion.” “Use requires only for other goal-slot schemas that are semantic prerequisites for this claim; do not include app names, actions, or concrete values.”
paragraphs.zh: “推断确定任务完成所需的最小目标槽位集合。”“requires 仅用于作为此声明语义前提的其他目标槽位模式；不要包含应用名称、操作或具体值。”

paragraphs.en: “Report only the listed outcomes whose verification conditions are visibly satisfied for the correct object and values. A draft, an attempt, or disappearance of a form alone is not confirmation.” “Use observations: [] when nothing is confirmed.”
paragraphs.zh: “仅报告列出的、且针对正确对象和取值可明显看到验证条件已满足的结果。 草稿、一次尝试、或表单的消失本身都不构成确认。” “当没有任何内容被确认时，使用 observations: []。”

sents.en: “Report only the listed outcomes whose verification conditions are visibly satisfied for the correct object and values.

paragraphs.en: The reviewer returns one decision per candidate, containing its anchor_id , effect_schema , source_validity (supported, ambiguous, or contradicted), retained_step_ids , cited_evidence_ids , and rationale. For a supported result, an optional operator_update contains same_operator_id and short descriptions of its inputs , outcome , and method .
paragraphs.zh: 审查者为每个候选项返回一个决定，其中包含其 anchor_id、effect_schema、source_validity（支持、模糊或矛盾）、retained_step_ids、cited_evidence_ids 和 rationale。 对于支持的结果，一个可选的 operator_update 包含 same_operator_id 以及对其输入、结果和方法的简短描述。

sents.en: The reviewer returns one decision per candidate, containing its anchor_id , effect_schema , source_validity (supported, ambiguous, or contradicted), retained_step_ids , cited_evidence_ids , and rationale.

paragraphs.en: An accepted local result supplies the candidate endpoint e e . For resource alignment, the implementation ranks recorded transitions up to the detected endpoint by H i = 4 ​ x i + 3 ​ n i + 2 ​ max ⁡ ( 0 , z i − y i ) H_{i}=4x_{i}+3n_{i}+2\max(0,z_{i}-y_{i}) . Here x i , y i , z i x_{i},y_{i},z_{i} are the fractions of claim tokens appearing in the action target, pre-action UI, and post-action UI, respectively; n i n_{i} is the fraction newly visible after the action. Claim tokens come from the proposed values, fields, and evidence text, with generic stop words removed. The highest-scoring transition is used, with later steps breaking ties, only if H i ≥ 0.35 H_{i}\geq 0.35 ; backdating additionally requires an exact claimed value in that transition’s visible post-action UI. Otherwise the detected endpoint is retained. Let r r be the earliest recorded availability step, before e e , among the candidate’s required inputs, and let p p be the previous captured advancement step strictly before e e . If a backdated endpoint is at or before the most recent advancement, that advancement does not constrain the start. The initial start is max ⁡ ( r , p + 1 ) \max(r,p+1) when both exist, r r or p + 1 p+1 when only one exists, and the episode start otherwise. The candidate contains the bounded suffix of this interval through e e ; the default setting retains at most eight steps. An empty recorded slice falls back to the detected transition as a single-step candidate. Thus the reviewer receives a local candidate rather than choosing an unrestricted interval from the full episode.
paragraphs.zh: 已接受的局部结果提供候选端点 e。 为进行资源对齐，实现将记录的转移按 H_i = 4x_i + 3n_i + 2max(0, z_i − y_i) 排序，直至检测到的端点。 其中 x_i、y_i、z_i 分别是声明令牌出现在动作目标、动作前 UI 和动作后 UI 中的比例；n_i 是动作后新可见部分的比例。 声明令牌来自提议的值、字段和证据文本，并去除了通用停用词。 得分最高的转移会被采用，后续步骤用于打破平局，且仅当 H_i ≥ 0.35 时才生效；回溯日期还要求该转移可见的动作后 UI 中存在完全匹配的声明值。 否则保留检测到的端点。 设 r 为候选所需输入中在 e 之前最早的记录可用步骤，设 p 为严格早于 e 的上一次捕获的推进步骤。 如果回溯日期后的端点位于最近一次推进之前或与之重合，则该推进不会约束起点。 当两者都存在时，初始起点为 max(r, p+1)；当只存在其一时，为 r 或 p+1；否则为回合起点。 候选包含该区间经 e 截断的有界后缀；默认设置最多保留八个步骤。 若记录的片段为空，则回退为以检测到的转移作为单步候选。 这样，评审者收到的是一个局部候选，而不是从完整回合中选择一个无约束的区间。

paragraphs.en: The reviewer chooses a nonempty subset of supplied step identifiers that includes e e , and cites evidence identifiers from the supplied packet. The host validates both sets. It then closes the selection over observed input support: input-entry steps not marked as making no progress, or selections of a result or recipient bound to a required input, identify the earliest supporting step. The retained route includes the nonempty, non-wait actions from there through e e . For acquisition without entry inputs, it also retains the navigation/read prefix from the latest recorded app opening, or the bounded prefix if no app opening is present. If required inputs have no identified support step, the validated reviewer selection is retained.
paragraphs.zh: 审阅者从提供的步骤标识符中选择一个包含 e e 的非空子集，并引用所提供数据包中的证据标识符。 主机验证这两个集合。 随后，主机会根据观察到的输入支持对选择进行闭包：未被标记为无进展的输入条目步骤，或与必需输入绑定的结果或接收方的选择，会确定最早的支持步骤。 保留的路径包含从该步骤到 e e 的非空、非等待动作。 对于没有输入条目的获取操作，还会保留从最近一次记录的应用程序打开开始的导航/读取前缀，如果不存在应用程序打开记录，则保留有界前缀。 如果必需输入没有确定的支持步骤，则保留经验证的审阅者选择。
